statement: For a connected holomorphic map from a complex S6 with b1(general fibre)=1 every reduced fibre is irreducible; a horizontal prime forces fibre normalizations outside class C. Without that Betti assumption every component of any reducible fibre has normalization outside class C
depends_on: E.2.5; Alexander duality; Leray invariant subspace; surface classification; Fujino2021 Lemma3.3
notes: Root and D full-source independent referee PASS; root accepted the reducible-fibre companion. Nonreduced fibres and locally self-crossing supports are explicit. E.2.9-E.2.10 subsequently remove the horizontal fixed-divisor obstruction.
